name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Feet shoulder-width, sit back and down to full depth, drive up through your heels.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest, squat to full depth keeping your torso upright.

name: Back Squat
instructions: Bar on your upper back, squat to depth with a braced core. Leave reps in the tank on working sets.

name: Front Squat
instructions: Bar racked across the front of your shoulders, elbows high, squat to depth staying upright.

name: Wall Sit
instructions: Back flat against a wall, thighs parallel to the floor, hold the position.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, drive your hips up by squeezing your glutes.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
instructions: Same as a glute bridge, one leg extended straight out, drive through the planted heel.

name: Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell)
instructions: Soft knees, hinge at the hips keeping the dumbbells close to your legs, feel a stretch in your hamstrings.

name: Deadlift
instructions: Bar over midfoot, flat back, drive the floor away through your heels.

name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Hip-hinge the kettlebell back between your legs, then snap your hips forward to drive it up.

name: Good Morning
instructions: Bar on your back, hinge forward at the hips with a flat back until you feel a hamstring stretch.

name: Reverse Lunge
instructions: Step back into a lunge, back knee toward the floor, drive through the front heel to stand.

name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Step forward into a lunge and continue forward, alternating legs.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Rear foot elevated on a bench, lower straight down on the front leg to depth.

name: Dumbbell Step-Up
instructions: Step fully onto a box or bench, drive through the lead leg without pushing off the trailing foot.

name: Lateral Lunge
instructions: Step wide to one side, sit back into that hip while keeping the other leg straight.

name: Pogo Hops
instructions: Stay on the balls of your feet, minimal ground contact, small quick hops.

name: Single-Leg Pogo Hops
instructions: Same as pogo hops on one leg: stiff ankle, quick ground contact.

name: Broad Jump
instructions: Jump forward for maximum distance, land soft and hold the landing for 2 seconds.

name: Box Jump
instructions: Jump onto a box, land soft with bent knees. Step down between reps, don't jump down.

name: Depth Drop to Stick
instructions: Step off a low box, absorb the landing, and freeze. No rebound jump.

name: Trap Bar Jump
instructions: Light load in a trap bar, jump with maximum intent. This is a speed-strength movement, not a max lift.

name: Squat Jump
instructions: Squat down and explode straight up as high as possible, landing soft.

name: Tuck Jump
instructions: Jump straight up, drive both knees to your chest, land soft.

name: Skater Hop
instructions: Hop laterally from one leg to the other, sticking each landing.

name: Full Approach Jump (submax)
instructions: Full run-up jump at 70-80% effort, grooving the pattern instead of maxing out.

name: Plank
instructions: Forearms and toes on the ground, body in a straight line, brace your core.

name: Side Plank
instructions: Balance on one forearm and the side of your foot, hips lifted in a straight line.

name: Dead Bug
instructions: Lying on your back, extend opposite arm and leg while keeping your low back pressed to the floor.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from a bar, raise your legs to hip height or higher without swinging.

name: Pallof Press
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height, press it straight out and resist rotating.

name: Hollow Body Hold
instructions: Lie on your back, lift shoulders and legs off the ground into a slight curve, brace hard.

name: Calf Raise
instructions: Rise onto the balls of your feet, pause, then lower under control.

name: Standing Calf Raise (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides, rise onto the balls of your feet with a full stretch at the bottom.

name: Weighted Calf Raise
instructions: Loaded calf raise on a machine or with a barbell, full range of motion.

name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Seated machine calf raise targeting the soleus, with full stretch and full contraction.

name: Banded Lateral Walk
instructions: Band around your ankles or knees, take side steps keeping tension on the band.

name: Ankle Mobility Flow
instructions: Knee-to-wall ankle rocks and calf stretches to open up ankle range of motion.

name: Hip Opener Flow
instructions: 90/90 switches and lunging hip flexor stretches to open up hip range of motion.

name: World's Greatest Stretch
instructions: Deep lunge with a rotational reach to the ceiling, alternating sides.
